issue.body:
### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://r.bouncycustom.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fr.bouncycustom.com%2F)

### Comment
> **Incorrect adult categorisation on the Family Protection server: bouncycustom.com / r.bouncycustom.com**
> 
> bouncycustom.com and its subdomain r.bouncycustom.com belong to Bouncy (https://bouncy.ai), a link-in-bio and link-management platform used by around 35,000 creators and small businesses. r.bouncycustom.com is a redirect endpoint only: it receives clicks from customers' own custom domains and forwards them to the customer's destination page. It hosts no content of its own (its root page shows only "Routing endpoint").
> 
> **What happens:** on the Family Protection server (family.adguard-dns.com), an A query for r.bouncycustom.com returns 94.140.14.35 instead of the real address 199.36.158.100 (Firebase Hosting). Safari then fails the TLS handshake with the sinkhole and shows "Safari can't open the page because it couldn't establish a secure connection to the server" (first screenshot). The same link works on cellular and on the Default server (second screenshot). bouncy.ai itself resolves normally on the Family server.
> 
> **Impact:** because every custom domain on the platform passes through this one redirect host, the block breaks all ~1,500 customer domains at once, including many non-adult businesses, for anyone on a network that uses the Family server.
> 
> **Why the categorisation is not appropriate:** the host does not serve sexual content. Where a customer's destination is age-restricted, the endpoint shows a plain age-confirmation page before redirecting, and the destination domain itself (for example onlyfans.com) is already categorised independently by the Family filter, so blocking the redirect host adds no protection. Comparable link services (linktr.ee, bit.ly, beacons.ai) resolve normally on the Family server.
> 
> **Request:** please recategorise bouncycustom.com and r.bouncycustom.com as a redirect / link-management service and remove them from the adult category on the Family Protection server.
> 
> Steps to reproduce: set DNS to family.adguard-dns.com, then open https://r.bouncycustom.com/ in any browser.

```
Username: @amaanmuhammad
```


### Screenshots

</details>

comment.body:
Apologies for the slow reply, I was away when you answered. Here are custom domains that pass through r.bouncycustom.com and lead to ordinary destinations:

- https://jade.openyoutube.app (YouTube video)
- https://onceplayy.com/max1 (YouTube Shorts)
- https://onceplayy.com/friend-member (YouTube Playables game)
- https://youby.me (WhatsApp business chat)
- https://lacykim.me (TikTok profile)
- https://keloune.com (Instagram profile)
- https://robertadipadua.me (Instagram profile)
- https://thewhiterabbitclub.world (Telegram community)

Each of these is a customer's own domain; the click goes through r.bouncycustom.com and on to the destination. On the Family server all of them fail with a TLS error because the shared redirect host is sinkholed, even though every destination above resolves normally on that server.

To be transparent: a large share of our customers are adult creators, and their destinations (onlyfans.com, fanvue.com, fansly.com) are already blocked by the Family filter on their own domains, so the redirect host adds nothing to protection there. It only breaks the non-adult customers. We would appreciate r.bouncycustom.com and bouncycustom.com being treated like other redirect services (linktr.ee, bit.ly, beacons.ai), which resolve normally on the Family server.

issue.title: intercelestial.com
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://intercelestial.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fintercelestial.com%2F) ### Comment > Anti-adblock wall on intercelestial.com cannot be bypassed or blocked > > The site uses "AntiAdBlock Core" to display a fixed-position popup dialog demanding the user disable their adblocker. The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. This makes static cosmetic filter rules ineffective. The element was visible in Brave's inspector but did not appear in LibreWolf's inspector on a separate load, which is consistent with the selectors rotating. > > What I have tried: > > AdGuard's element picker cannot select the overlay. The page is frozen while the overlay is active, making the picker non-functional. > Disabling JavaScript removes all page content, not just the overlay. The site is fully JS-dependent so this is not a workaround. > Manual inspection found the injected HTML (included below) but the randomized attributes prevent writing a persistent blocking rule. > > Injected overlay HTML (captured from one session in Brave): > > <div data-c30b98078-card="" style="position:fixed;top:12vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)..." role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> > <!-- "Adblocker detected" dialog with buttons "I've disabled it" / "Reload page" --> > <!-- Footer: intercelestial.com · powered by AntiAdBlock Core --> > </div> > ### Screenshots

issue.body:
### Issue URL (Annoyance) [https://intercelestial.com/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fintercelestial.com%2F) ### Comment > Anti-adblock wall on intercelestial.com cannot be bypassed or blocked > > The site uses "AntiAdBlock Core" to display a fixed-position popup dialog demanding the user disable their adblocker. The popup is centered on the page with a greyed-out backdrop that freezes all interaction with the underlying content using aria-modal="true". Other users have also reported that disabling their adblocker does not always clear the popup. > > Neither AdGuard nor uBlock Origin detects or filters this overlay. > > The overlay uses randomized data-attribute selectors (e.g. data-c30b98078-card, data-c30b98078-retry, ID nbb5d4466-title) that appear to change between sessions or page loads. This makes static cosmetic filter rules ineffective. The element was visible in Brave's inspector but did not appear in LibreWolf's inspector on a separate load, which is consistent with the selectors rotating. > > What I have tried: > > AdGuard's element picker cannot select the overlay. The page is frozen while the overlay is active, making the picker non-functional. > Disabling JavaScript removes all page content, not just the overlay. The site is fully JS-dependent so this is not a workaround. > Manual inspection found the injected HTML (included below) but the randomized attributes prevent writing a persistent blocking rule. > > Injected overlay HTML (captured from one session in Brave): > > <div data-c30b98078-card="" style="position:fixed;top:12vh;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)..." role="dialog" aria-modal="true"> > <!-- "Adblocker detected" dialog with buttons "I've disabled it" / "Reload page" --> > <!-- Footer: intercelestial.com · powered by AntiAdBlock Core --> > </div> > ### Screenshots

issue.title: www.youtube.com

labels.name: T: Incorrect Blocking
labels.description: Website or app not working properly due to filtering

labels.name: A: Cannot reproduce
labels.description: Filters devs cannot reproduce this issue

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: Implement AdGuard Polish filter
issue.body:
Related issue: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/FiltersRegistry/issues/1250

Since there are so many rules, categorizing them will take some time.
I suggest we first copy the relevant rules from foreign.txt and then gradually sort through them, removing comments where they aren't needed or aren't typically included.

The anchor structure should be borrowed from other filters.

comment.body: https://github.com/AdguardTeam/FiltersRegistry/issues/1250#issuecomment-5791741903 (if the rules have any value after 3 years)

issue.title: raw.githubusercontent.com
issue.body:
### Issue URL (Ads) [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/refs/heads/master/BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fraw.githubusercontent.com%2FAdguardTeam%2FAdguardFilters%2Frefs%2Fheads%2Fmaster%2FBaseFilter%2Fsections%2Fforeign.txt) ### Comment > I propose creating the AdGuard Polish Filter. > > # Why is the AdGuard Polish Filter necessary? > > ## Internet Usage > > According to the W3C, the amount of content on the Internet by language is as follows: > https://w3techs.com/technologies/overview/content_language > Let’s focus on the languages for which AdGuard does not have its own filters: > > - Italian: 2.8% > - Polish: 1.8% > - Czech & Slovak (combined): 1.3% > > Polish is a widely used language on the internet, more so than Turkish or Chinese. > > ## Number of Rules in AdGuard > > Furthermore, ad blocking is very popular in Poland, and AdGuard has received a large number of issues related to it. > > As a result, in the foreign languages section of the AdGuard Base Filter, Polish rules are disproportionately numerous, accounting for about one-third of the total. > https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/BaseFilter/sections/foreign.txt > > Currently, the number of Polish rules in the foreign languages section of the Base Filter has already surpassed the number of rules in the AdGuard Dutch Filter. > > ## Benefits of Creating an AdGuard Polish Filter > > There are many benefits. > > - Polish speakers will find it easier to use the extensive set of Polish rules in the AdGuard Base Filter for various purposes. For example, when using uBlock Origin, they will be able to select AdGuard’s Polish rules without having to use the AdGuard Base Filter. > - There are benefits for non-Polish speakers as well. Currently, the large number of Polish rules included in the base filter are unnecessary for non-Polish speakers, yet nearly all users are forced to have them as part of the base filter. Since reducing the number of rules is a key challenge for MV3 browser extensions and mobile environments, separating them into a standalone file will help conserve rule count. > - This is just speculation, but there may also be benefits for filter maintainers. There are a great many Polish-language issues, and a standalone file might be easier to manage. > > # How will this be implemented? > > There is no need to add new rules. AdGuard’s Polish rules are already very comprehensive. > > - First, move the Polish rules from the foreign languages section of the AdGuard Base Filter to a separate file. > - Merge that file with the “Official Polish Filters” and “Polish Anti Adblock Filters” to create the AdGuard Polish filter. > - The “Official Polish Filters” and “Polish Anti Adblock Filters” were previously marked as AdGuard’s recommended filters; remove this designation. > > Please consider this. ### Screenshots

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

<details>
<summary>Detailed description for iOS users</summary>

1. Install [**Usercripts**](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/userscripts/id1463298887) app
2. Enable **Usercripts** extension in Safari settings
	* iOS 18+: `System settings` => `Apps` => `Safari` => `Extensions`
	* iOS 17 and older: `System settings` => `Safari` => `Extensions`
	Find **Usercripts**, enable it and allow `On other sites` permission
4. Open the [tinyShield ](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@filteringdev/tinyshield@latest/dist/tinyShield.user.js) userscript URL in browser
5. Press the extensions icon in the address bar of Safari and select Userscripts 
6. Tap to install
7. In opened popup, scroll down and press Install button
8. Done.

</details>

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.body:
# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

<details>
<summary>Detailed description for iOS users</summary>

1. Install [**Usercripts**](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/userscripts/id1463298887) app
2. Enable **Usercripts** extension in Safari settings
	* iOS 18+: `System settings` => `Apps` => `Safari` => `Extensions`
	* iOS 17 and older: `System settings` => `Safari` => `Extensions`
	Find **Usercripts**, enable it and allow `On other sites` permission
4. Open the [tinyShield ](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@filteringdev/tinyshield@latest/dist/tinyShield.user.js) userscript URL in browser
5. Press the extensions icon in the address bar of Safari and select Userscripts 
6. Tap to install
7. In opened popup, scroll down and press Install button
8. Done.

</details>

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

### Prerequisites

- [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml);

AdGuard gets detected on a website

### Add your comment and screenshots

# Comment
On this site's anti-adblock detection is triggered when the **Japanese filter (full version)** is enabled. The **optimized version of the same filter does not reproduce the issue**.

 - Full: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7.txt
 - Optimized: https://filters.adtidy.org/ios/filters/7_optimized.txt

 ## Reproduction Results
 
 | Filters enabled | Result |
 |---|---|
 | Japanese (full) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Japanese (optimized) only | Normal (OK) |
 | Base + Japanese (full) | Anti-adblock **IS shown** (NG) |
 | Base + Japanese (optimized) | Normal (OK) |
 | Base only | Normal (OK) |
 

 ## Note on the optimized filter as a workaround
 
 Switching to the optimized filter is not a viable workaround here. I browse a wide range of sites as part of my work, and the optimized list drops rules that the full list needs to cover them. Falling back to the optimized list and then reporting each missed site individually would defeat the purpose of the optimization, so I would like the full list itself to be fixed.
 
 ## Steps Already Tried (none resolved the issue)
 
 - Updated the filter rules to the latest version
 - Updated the AdGuard iOS app to the latest version
 - Restarted the device
 - Cleared Safari's cache
 - Disabled all content blockers in Safari settings and enabled them again
 - Restarted Safari
 - Restarted AdGuard
 - Checked for filter updates in AdGuard (wait 1 min)
 
 ## Additional Information
 
 - The only Safari extension enabled is AdGuard, so interference from other extensions can be ruled out.
 - Switching between the full and optimized lists was done with a full filter update in between.
 - I believe this is the same as or similar to issue #241409.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/bvCfNtdc/image.png)

</details>

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking)
[https://aax-fe.amazon.co.jp/](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Faax-fe.amazon.co.jp%2F)

### Comment
> Amazon.co.jpのトップページに並んでいるおすすめ商品画像のうち「スポンサー」マークのついたものはリンク先がhttps://www.amazon.co.jpではなくhttps://aax-fe.amazon.co.jpになっているようです。
> 
> AdGuard DNSを有効にした状態ではhttps://www.amazon.co.jpから始まるURLは開けますが、https://aax-fe.amazon.co.jpから始まるものは開けません。
> 
> AdGuard DNSを無効化した状態でhttps://aax-fe.amazon.co.jpから始まるリンクをクリックすると最終的にhttps://www.amazon.co.jpにリダイレクトされますが、有効化した状態ではリダイレクトがされずに添付画像のようなエラーメッセージがSafariから出力されました。

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

issue.title: [BUG] You can’t log in at maccosmetics.com if you have the AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter enabled
issue.body: ### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material, otherwise use [NSFW-specific form](./new?template=bug_report_NSFW.yml); - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue; - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date; - [x] Browser version is up-to-date; - [x] If the site or app is broken, disabling AdGuard protection resolves an issue. ### What product do you use? Other ad blocker ### AdGuard version wBlock 3.1.0 (1094) ### What type of problem have you encountered? Website or app doesn't work properly ### Which browser(s) do you use? Safari ### Which device do you use? Desktop ### Where is the problem encountered? https://www.maccosmetics.com/ ### Ad Blocking AdGuard Base filter ### Privacy AdGuard Tracking Protection filter ### Social Widgets _No response_ ### Annoyances _No response_ ### Security Online Malicious URL Blocklist ### Other _No response_ ### DNS filters _No response_ ### Language-specific _No response_ ### What Stealth Mode options do you have enabled? _No response_ ### Add your comment and screenshots 1. I’m using wBlock for macOS, which in turn makes use of the _AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter_. It would seem that if you have the AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter enabled and if then you try to log in at maccosmetics.com, Safari ends up in a redirect loop, and you get a “Too many redirects” error. **Steps to reproduce the behavior:** 1. First, enable the AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter in your ad blocker of choice. 2. Then open https://www.maccosmetics.com/ in Safari on macOS. 3. And then click on the avatar icon in the top right on the page to try to load the MAC Cosmetics login screen. * Expected behavior MAC Cosmetics’ login page loads. * Actual behavior: Safari ends up in a redirect loop, and you get a “Too many redirects” error. 2. Screenshots I like buying makeup from MAC Cosmetics, so when I first came across this issue, I individually disabled the filters in app one by one until I found the one that was causing the issue (which in this case turned out to be the _AdGuard URL Tracking Protection Filter_). And I was able to confirm that once I disabled that filter, I could load the login page at maccosmetics.com. ### Privacy - [x] I agree to follow this condition
